rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: _share_html_response in server.py originally composed `base = f'{request.url.scheme}://{request.url.netloc}'`, so whichever host the crawler hit (Slack/iMessage/WhatsApp/Twitter scraping the share endpoint via the preview-backend URL the sharer pasted) became the canonical in OG metadata. Net effect: when an owner shared a product link generated in the preview/cluster environment, the cached OG card (and the refresh/replace redirect) pointed back at the preview/cluster host, not at networkcapitalapp.co.za. Fix: hardcode `base = 'https://networkcapitalapp.co.za'` in _share_html_response (server.py line 5643), and mirror the same hardcoded base in the two frontend share emitters (SharedProductPage shareUrl + ShareMenu backend constant). og:image deliberately remains request-host-relative because uploaded images physically live on the backend pod that received the upload. Reproduction (BEFORE fix): curl https://mongo-dump-viewer.preview.emergentagent.com/api/share/p/owner/iter56-lean-live | grep canonical → returned the preview host. Reproduction (AFTER fix, this run): same curl → returns https://networkcapitalapp.co.za. Mitigation: 20/20 pytest assertions now lock down all 4 URL emission points across all 5 share endpoints, so the regression cannot reappear unnoticed.
